title: Grafana GitHub token breach and repository download incident
summary: Source-backed advisory for a developer-token compromise where a missed GitHub workflow token led to source-code and internal-repository access after a supply-chain attack.

safe_versions: Not versioned; review GitHub audit logs, token scope, and repository access.

detection_rationale: The incident class is source-backed GitHub token misuse rather than a package artifact compromise.
Behavioral detection should key on workflow token exposure, repository enumeration/download, unusual GitHub API access, and compromised CI workflows.
Local package usage should not downgrade the severity of a source-backed GitHub token/repository incident.
remediation: Rotate impacted GitHub workflow, automation, and personal access tokens and review token scopes.
Audit GitHub access logs for repository enumeration, archive downloads, clone bursts, Git Data API activity, and unusual actors.
Review workflows initially considered unaffected and revalidate them against source-backed incident timelines.
Treat downloaded private source and operational repositories as exposed until investigation proves otherwise.
